script.short_of_target: The script came out around {estimated_s}s of the {target_s}s you asked for — the model wrote {words} words of narration, and narration is what sets the length. Lower the target duration, or switch to a larger script model, for the full length.

export.music_bed_dropped: The music track could not be read (usually a placeholder from a machine with no music model), so this video was exported without music. Install a music model and regenerate the music for a scored cut.
